content:
- Finished the observer-container removal task end to end.
- Final architecture: two checked-in HA compose variants, tiny include-only per-run compose file, no observer service/model in topology/givens/world, host-side HA observation over published ports, and host-side psql primary probing using the existing observer TLS identity with 0600 key permissions.
- Validation completed successfully: make check, make test, make test-long, then docs changes, then make lint again after docs edits.
- Ran task_switch.sh and updated the Ralph task file to status done with passes=true; next step is to stage only the task-related files plus .ralph bookkeeping, commit, and push.
